text.content:
Decay · Entropy · A Constant, Not a Character

Everything in Cinderfall agrees on one point: whatever this is, it was never a "someone." No account exists, anywhere, pre- or post-Turning, of it intervening for an individual, granting a vision, answering a prayer directed at it personally, or even acknowledging that prayers exist. It simply runs — the way radioactive decay runs, the way heat bleeds toward cold, the way a wall built against the sea eventually loses. Reckoners don't have a relationship with it. They've found a place to stand close enough to something that large that a little of what it's always doing spills onto them.
